description: Hands a task from the Supervisor to a worker agent within an already-resolved scope. Carries scope, governance, prior-stage output, and stage identifier so the worker has full context without re-deriving it.
checklist: 1. Confirm the caller is the Supervisor (or Router for single-step direct hand-offs); workers must not call this

2. Validate the payload contains: target_agent, scope_path, scope_authority_file, governance_refs (may be empty), stage (scaffold|generate|validate|test|review|curate|learn), task_description, previous_output (may be null on first stage)
3. Verify target_agent matches the stage (scaffold→scaffolder, generate→generator, validate→validator, test→tester, review→reviewer, curate→curator, learn→learner); reject mismatches
4. Refuse delegation that crosses scope_path; if the task implies a different module, return to Router instead
5. Hand off and wait for the worker's structured output
6. Call `log-action` to record the delegation (stage, target, scope)
